xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for GitHub issue #4027 bound recut: lean-timing is round sibling completeness, not spend.

plan.title: bug(design-critique): N>=3 lean-after-each-EXIT talks at 1 of 3

narratives.Description: Recut design-critique lean-timing from each critic EXIT to this round's sibling completeness. Bound contract is successor lean 5488350584 and synthesis 5488413872, not the original issue draft.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4027. Bound recut: synthesis 5488413872, successor lean 5488350584, operator confirm 5488407656.
narratives.Overview: Issue #4027 was recut on 2026-09-01 after an open-critique panel plus Stop 4 retry. The original filing's N=1 vs N>=3 spend-keyed split does not bind. Silence follows this round's sibling completeness, using the same unqualified same-round-unposted conjunct the bind guards already use. Spend stays an arc permission field, not the wait rule. The critic brief does not carry a parent-silence-until switch. Empty-lean verb menus stay forbidden; that ban waits on this round's lean rather than on each critic EXIT. A lean that closes a round of two or more names the dispatched sibling count and those comment ids. Parent dispatch bookkeeping is the trigger; thread posts corroborate; do not count self-attested role: critic lines as panel-complete. Recut every each-EXIT locus (contract 214/216/218/228/230/331 and both skill pointers) via pack source then packs:render. Line 218 is a qualifier swap, not a deletion. Do not deposit-qualify the new silence MUST. Fences: no new skill, no new completeness predicate (#3850), no paste-prompts (#3962), no host PATH in AGENTS.md. Content-contract tests update pinned strings only. Halt line remains postable while siblings are unposted. Codex heading 2 half B (derive timing from recorded spend) stays disagreed.
narratives.UserStory: As the operator of a same-round critique panel, I want the parent to stay silent until this round's siblings are posted, so the first lean and verb menu are over a complete census rather than 1 of 3.
narratives.When: When a same-round panel is in flight, parent does not post the successor lean or print the verb menu while same-round siblings remain unposted.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Bind to synthesis 5488413872 and successor lean 5488350584, not the issue-body spend split. Drop parent-silence-until. Do not recut #3850. Do not add a skill. Do not add a completeness predicate. Line 218 qualifier swap, not deletion. Empty-lean verb menu string stays in the loop. named on the panel-deposit stays pinned out. Codex heading 2 half B remains disagree.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Recut Operator-gated loop, Successor lean, and Operator verbs onto the unqualified same-round-unposted conjunct; qualifier-swap line 218; add dispatched-sibling-count citation on a lean that closes a round of two or more; halt line stays postable. 2. Thin skill pointers via pack source then task packs:render. 3. Recut content-contract pinned strings only. 4. CHANGELOG Unreleased. Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/design_critique_contract.test.ts. Closes #4027.

items.title: Lean-timing MUST is round sibling completeness using the unqualified same-round-unposted conjunct; spend stays permission

narrative.When: When the design-critique contract is read, successor lean and verb menu wait while same-round siblings remain unposted; Stop 2 spend is not the wait rule.
narrative.Acceptance: When content/contracts/design-critique.md is read, Operator-gated loop, Successor lean, and Operator verbs gate the first lean and verb menu on the unqualified conjunct same-round siblings remain unposted, not on N=1 vs N>=3 spend. Spend remains an arc permission field.

items.title: Drop parent-silence-until from the critic brief; do not add a parent switch to the critic envelope

narrative.When: When the critic brief template is read, it has no parent-silence-until field.
narrative.Acceptance: When content/templates/design-critique-brief.md is read, parent-silence-until is absent. The contract and skill do not add a parent timing switch to the critic envelope.

items.title: Parent dispatch bookkeeping is the completeness trigger; a lean closing a round of two or more names dispatched sibling count and cites those comment ids

narrative.When: When a successor lean closes a round of two or more, it names dispatched sibling count and cites those comment ids; self-attested role: critic lines are not panel-complete.
narrative.Acceptance: When the Successor lean section is read, it requires a lean closing a round of two or more to name that round's dispatched sibling count and cite each sibling comment id. The contract forbids counting self-attested role: critic lines as panel-complete. Parent dispatch bookkeeping is the trigger; thread posts corroborate.

items.title: Recut every each-EXIT locus (214/216/218/228/230/331 and both skill pointers) via pack source then packs:render

narrative.When: When the contract loop, successor lean, operator verbs, and thin skill are read, none still require a lean after each critic EXIT.
narrative.Acceptance: Contract sentences around 214/216/218/228/230/331 and both skill pointers (Stops list and Motion shape) wait on this round's sibling completeness. Pack source is content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json; rendered SKILL.md is not the SoT.

items.title: Line 218 is a qualifier swap, not a deletion; empty-lean verb menu remains in the loop and waits on this round's successor lean

narrative.When: When Operator-gated loop is read, empty-lean verb menu is still forbidden and waits on this round's successor lean.
narrative.Acceptance: The loop section still contains the pinned string empty-lean verb menu. The prohibition waits on this round's successor lean, not each critic EXIT. The sentence is not deleted.

items.title: Do not deposit-qualify the new silence MUST; named on the panel-deposit stays pinned out

narrative.When: When the new silence MUST is read, it uses the unqualified same-round-unposted conjunct; deposit remains the Envelope and ceiling expected-count record.
narrative.Acceptance: The contract does not contain named on the panel-deposit or panel-deposit for this round. Panel-deposit stays the durable expected-count record in Envelope and ceiling.

items.title: Fences: no new skill, no new completeness predicate, no paste-prompts, no host PATH in AGENTS.md

narrative.When: When the change lands, the skills pack, always-pin list, and AGENTS.md do not gain a new skill, completeness predicate, paste-prompt, or host PATH.
narrative.Acceptance: No new skill is added. evaluateParentAudit / evaluateCompletedArcRecord gain no sibling-counting predicate. The skill stays a thin pointer without paste-prompts. AGENTS.md has no host PATH or binaries for this change.

items.title: Content-contract tests recut pinned each-EXIT strings only; no new live completeness predicate

narrative.When: When design_critique_contract.test.ts is run, it fails closed if the recut wording is dropped, and it does not add a live completeness predicate.
narrative.Acceptance: packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/design_critique_contract.test.ts pins the new round-completeness wording and no longer pins After each critic EXIT as the loop MUST. No new live completeness predicate is introduced.

narrative.When: When CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, it records the panel-silence recut and closes #4027.
narrative.Acceptance: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has a brief release-notes entry for the round-sibling lean-timing recut and closes #4027.
